parsed.name: 欧陆过程仪表
parsed.description: 欧陆的串行过程仪表，可通过 RS485 或 RS232 使用 Modbus RTU/ASCII 通信。在实验室和工业环境中常用于读取与设置过程参数，如温度或其他工艺变量；具体测量与控制能力取决于所连接的型号。
parsed.description_en: A Eurotherm serial process instrument that communicates over RS485 or RS232 using Modbus RTU or ASCII. In laboratories and industrial settings it is commonly used to read and set process parameters, such as temperature or other process variables; the exact measurement and control functions depend on the connected model.
